origin.description: Append a directory to PATH, then restore it.
origin.details: The default action is prefix. Entries are normalized to absolute paths and joined with the platform separator.
origin.example:
dir.create("/tmp/withr-path-marker", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
before <- Sys.getenv("PATH")
last <- local({
  local_path("/tmp/withr-path-marker", "suffix")
  parts <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("PATH"), .Platform$path.sep)[[1]]
  parts[[length(parts)]]
})
c(last, if (identical(Sys.getenv("PATH"), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Append a directory to PATH, then restore it.
translation.details: The default action is prefix. Entries are normalized to absolute paths and joined with the platform separator. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.makedirs("/tmp/withr-path-marker", exist_ok=True)
before = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
with local_path("/tmp/withr-path-marker", action="suffix"):
    last = os.environ["PATH"].split(os.pathsep)[-1]
flag = "restored" if os.environ.get("PATH", "") == before else "open"
return [last, flag]
